subject: Problem: UI input changes do not update when switching across navbarPages

messages.author: 28722f4922e8b1f3
messages.subject: Problem: UI input changes do not update when switching across navbarPages
parts:
I have tried to keep this reproducible example as small as possible to illustrate the problem. Apologies for the length.

The problem:  I like the visual layout of "navbarPages" for switching between "Tabs", rather than using "tabsetPanels" in a shiny app.  But I can't get changes in input selections in navbarPages to update correctly, when switching across tabs/pages.  I imagine others have stumbled across this problem already in some form or another.

Consider this simple example which works exactly the way I would like (and then program 2 following, which has the problem):

#************ program 1 using tabsetPanels ***********************

library(shiny)
# This application works the way I want it to, no problems except the it's perhaps not so visually appealing

shinyUI(fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Old Faithful Geyser Data"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("choice", label = "choice:", 
                  choices = c("Canada", "USA")),
      submitButton("Calculate"),
      width = 3
    ),

    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("panel 1",
          plotOutput("distPlot")
        ),
        tabPanel("panel 2 (10 times bigger x)",
          plotOutput("distPlot2")
        )
      )
    )
  )
))


shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    if (input$choice == "Canada") {
      x    <- faithful[, 2]
    } else if (input$choice == "USA") {
      x    <- faithful[, 1]
    }
    bins <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 31)
    hist(x, breaks = bins, col = 'darkgray', border = 'white')

  })
  
  output$distPlot2 <- renderPlot({
    if (input$choice == "Canada") {
      x    <- faithful[, 2] * 10
    } else if (input$choice == "USA") {
      x    <- faithful[, 1] * 10
    }
    bins <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 31)
    hist(x, breaks = bins, col = 'darkgray', border = 'white')
    
  })

})

#**************************** end program 1*****************

Note that in program 1 above, if you switch top panel 2, and change from Canada to USA, hit calculate, and then later switch back to panel 1, you see the plot for USA in Panel 1 (the user doesn't have to switch from Canada to USA, because that just happened on Panel 2).  This type of user functionality is what I want in program 2 below, but I can't get it to work yet (for lazy users of my app :) ).


#************ program 2 using navbarPages ***********************

library(shiny)
# Exactly same interactive functionality as previous apporach with just tabsets.
# This application does not work correctly on panel 2.  Changing the inputs on panel 2 does NOT update the plot in panel 2.  Must go back to panel 1 to update the plot.

# Exactly same interactive functionality as previous apporach with just tabsets.
# This application does not work correctly on panel 2.  Changing the inputs on panel 2 does NOT update the plot in panel 2.  Must go back to panel 1 to update the plot.

shinyUI(navbarPage("Old Faithful Geyser Data",
  tabPanel("panel 1",
           fluidPage(
             sidebarLayout(
               sidebarPanel(
                 selectInput("choice", label = "choice:", 
                             choices = c("Canada", "USA")),
                 submitButton("Calculate"),
                 width = 3
               ),
               mainPanel(
                  plotOutput("distPlot")
                )
             )
           )
  ),
  tabPanel("panel 2",
           fluidPage(
             sidebarLayout(
               sidebarPanel(
                 selectInput("choice", label = "choice:", 
                             choices = c("Canada", "USA")),
                 submitButton("Calculate"),
                 width = 3
               ),
               mainPanel(
                 plotOutput("distPlot2")
               )
             )
           )
  )

))


#Use the same server.R script as for program 1.


#**************************** end program 2*****************

Reproducing the problem in the live program:

Try switching to panel 2 in program 2, change from Canada to USA, and click calculate.  Nothing happens! (Same with a large number of input variables, not shown here to keep the example simple) You can of course Go back to panel 1, change to USA, hit calculate, then go to panel 2 to see the USA data (but the default input choice on panel 2 says Canada - not right).  This problem obviously defeats nice features of shiny apps.

A half solution:

One "half" solution to this problem is to define new ui variables in program 2 (and update the server.R script accordingly). For example, on panel 2, one could rename the names of the input variable to choice2 like so (see bold):

tabPanel("panel 2",
           fluidPage(
             sidebarLayout(
               sidebarPanel(
                 selectInput("choice2", label = "choice:", 
                             choices = c("Canada", "USA")),
                 submitButton("Calculate"),
                 width = 3
               ),
               mainPanel(
                 plotOutput("distPlot2")
               )
             )
           )
  )

But by using different variable names, now when the user switches from Panel 1 to Panel 2, the input selections do not correspond.  E.g. change from Canada to USA in Panel1, hit calculate, jump to panel to and see the choice is back to Canada.  "Lazy" users obviously want the two panels to have consistent selections when clicking across tabs/pages, like in program 1 above.

Is there a way to fix this interactive input update problem in program 2?

Many thanks in advance for any help.
